$comment: Permission and access requests to government bodies. Checked by services/ingestion/tests/permission-registry.test.ts. A request is recorded as sent only with the date and reference of the actual request; nothing here is inferred, and silence is never recorded as consent. Statuses: not_sent, draft_ready, sent, acknowledged, granted, refused, not_required, credential_needed.

requests.department: National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency (NRIDA), Ministry of Rural Development
requests.dataset: PMGSY OMMAS work-level register: sanction, physical and financial progress, completion
requests.access_method: Public web reports at pmgsy.dord.gov.in, no login (92 report routes observed)
requests.restrictions: "the Materials may not be copied, reproduced, modified, published, republished, uploaded, downloaded, posted, transmitted, or distributed in any way, without NRIDA's prior written permission" (pmgsy.dord.gov.in/Home/HomeLegalNotice/, fetched 2026-08-28)

requests.dataset: BEAMS departmental budget, release and expenditure (actuals)
requests.access_method: Public web export at beams.mahakosh.gov.in; robots.txt 404 (no stated restriction)
requests.restrictions: "Material featured on this website may be reproduced free of charge after taking proper permission by sending a mail to us." (finance.maharashtra.gov.in/en/website-policies/, fetched 2026-08-28). Collected for internal checking; not displayed (PUBLISH_BEAMS_FIGURES off).

requests.department: Each issuing department on the 21 collected GePNIC state portals
requests.dataset: Tender details: organisation chain, location, value, EMD
requests.access_method: Public web pages of each state's GePNIC portal; robots.txt permits
requests.restrictions: Reproduction requires the issuing department's permission (written, for Madhya Pradesh); linking needs none. Held and counted, not displayed (PUBLISH_TENDER_DETAILS off), per ADR-056.

requests.department: Public Works Department, Government of Maharashtra (Joint Secretary (Services), Mantralaya — the office named as Web Information Manager on pwd.maharashtra.gov.in)

requests.access_method: (1) None permitted: mahapwd.gov.in serves robots.txt Disallow: /. (2) pwd.maharashtra.gov.in permits crawling (Disallow: /wp-admin/ only); documents on cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in
requests.restrictions: (1) robots.txt Disallow: / (verified 2026-09-30). (2) Website copyright policy: reproduction free of charge after permission obtained by email; accurately, not derogatory or misleading, source acknowledged (read 2026-09-30).
